comments.text: Watching a barrier island fight erosion raises a difficult question: how do communities decide which areas are worth rebuilding after major storms? At what point does protecting homes become less practical than allowing the shoreline to change naturally? I'm curious how Dauphin Island residents feel about that trade-off.

replies.author: @suchalife3
replies.text: I'm a Resident as stated. It is terrifying and unsettling  knowing the next storm, or high tide may take us all out for good..better or worse. The homes that sit on land as well as the Marina face major consequences and decisions  each time another storm, high tide or high winds hit us. We've all..US ISLANDERS have chosen this beautiful living status and deep down understand with each passing storm..our way of Peaceful life..may be our last. It ALL COMES BACK TWO-FOLD..so we hope, pray, and take each day Slowly In faith, yet with strong Perseverance  for a Safer tomorrow.
